notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast Versus Enemies episode 48 with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for solar synergy and end-game content. The Bray Inheritance trait is really useful for PvE, returning from 0.46% to 2% ability energy from hits (the amount depends on the weapon archetype). Good stats by comparison with other rapid-fire scouts, and there are a couple of ways to go with your roll. The first thing to do is sort out the recoil direction with Arrowhead Brake, which also helps handling a bit. Tactical Mag or Flared Magwell add stability and reload speed (and an extra bullet for Tac Mag). Rapid Hit or Perpetual Motion layers more stability and reload speed - stability is good to help stay on a crit spot. Incandescent is great for add clear and hits your solar verbs. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Minor or Taken Spec mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-MinorSpec, PvE-EndGame, PvE-God, Controller, M+KB

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast Versus Enemies episode 48 with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for melee builds. The Bray Inheritance trait is really useful for PvE, returning from 0.46% to 2% ability energy from hits (the amount depends on the weapon archetype). Good stats by comparison with other rapid-fire scouts, and there are a couple of ways to go with your roll. The first thing to do is sort out the recoil direction with Arrowhead Brake, which also helps handling a bit. Tactical Mag or Flared Magwell add stability and reload speed (and an extra bullet for Tac Mag). For melee builds, Pugilist and Swashbuckler are the natural choice - get a melee kill for a refreshable 33% damage boost, and then each hit regenerates a little melee energy from the origin trait, while each kill regenerates a full 10%. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Minor or Taken Spec mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-MinorSpec, PvE-God, Controller, M+KB

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast Versus Enemies episode 48 with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for end-game activities. The Bray Inheritance trait is really useful for PvE, returning from 0.46% to 2% ability energy from hits (the amount depends on the weapon archetype). Good stats by comparison with other rapid-fire scouts, and there are a couple of ways to go with your roll. The first thing to do is sort out the recoil direction with Arrowhead Brake, which also helps handling a bit. Tactical Mag or Flared Magwell add stability and reload speed (and an extra bullet for Tac Mag). For end-game use, Reconstruction overfills your magazine by 100%, so if you hit 9 crits, you have 11 seconds (12s when enhanced) to use the 27 remaining shots with Focused Fury's 20% damage boost. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Minor or Taken Spec mod. Tags: PvE, PvE-MinorSpec, PvE-God, Controller, M+KB

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range/Stability] [Requires Counterbalance Stock] "Trustee is fantastic. You absolutely want Reconstruction in Col. 3, and then Col. 4 is a little weaker, so you can choose between the softer buff of Redirection, accuracy bonuses with Eye of the Storm, or just generating ability energy with Wellspring. High-Impact Reserves are good on paper, but having tried it, it doesn't trigger enough in practice simply due to how good Reconstruction is." tags:pve
